title: Founding a colony: three lineages, pick one
question: C used to drop twelve identical ants. Now it offers three. Does this read as a decision worth making — and can you tell at a glance which of the three you want?
context_md:
**3 lineages on offer** at 224 / 321 / 178 power against a pool of 600, so all three are affordable and the choice is not made for you.

**Rolled, over 3,600 slots measured:** 28.7% of trait slots land neutral and draw no line at all; 29.7% land strong. So a lineage says two or three things about itself, not six. A uniform draw would make every candidate loud (~55% strong) and none of them mean anything.

**Stocks** are real species with real differences — HOPPER jumps, LONG ANT is six cells and survives a bite that kills a two-cell ant, PALE CHITIN is plated from birth at twice the ant's armour.

Walking away (X) costs nothing and leaves the same three. Only committing rerolls them.

Things I am unsure about and would rather you told me than guessed: whether the cost numbers mean anything to you yet, whether the founder dial (Q/E, 4-24) is discoverable, and whether the trait words say enough.
